"GAME DEVELOPMENT PROMPT: REALISTIC 3D CRICKET CAREER GAME

Create a complete, highly realistic 3D cricket career game inspired by the gameplay quality and features of World Cricket Championship 2 (WCC2) and modern cricket simulation games.

Game Title: Real Cricket Career 3D

1. Graphics @COMMENT_BODY@ Gameplay

- High-quality realistic 3D graphics.
- Realistic human player models, faces, movements and animations.
- Beautiful international cricket stadiums with audience, boundary boards, floodlights and pitch details.
- Realistic bat-ball physics.
- Smooth animations and realistic sound effects.
- Optimized for Android mobile devices.

2. Career Mode

Start as a young local cricket player and build a professional cricket career.

Career progression:

1. Local Cricket
2. District Cricket
3. State Cricket
4. Domestic Cricket
5. IPL-style T20 League
6. International Cricket
7. World Cup

Performance should affect player selection, reputation, rankings and career opportunities.

3. Realistic Batting System

- Control batting by swiping in different directions.
- Play cover drive, straight drive, pull shot, cut shot, sweep, flick and lofted shots.
- Add defensive shots and leave-ball controls.
- Different timing should produce different shot results.
- Add realistic edges, misses, boundaries and sixes.
- Include a batting camera that follows the ball.

4. Realistic Bowling System

- Choose fast bowling, medium pace, off-spin and leg-spin.
- Control line, length, speed and swing.
- Add yorkers, bouncers, slower balls and variations.
- Realistic bowling run-up and delivery animations.

5. Advanced Fielding System

- Control fielders manually.
- Catching opportunities should allow the user to control the player.
- Add diving catches, ground fielding, throwing and run-outs.
- Show a realistic close-up camera during important catches.
- Add wicketkeeper animations and stumpings.

6. Non-Striker System

This feature is extremely important:

- When my player is batting as the striker, I control every shot.
- When my player is at the non-striker's end, the AI controls the striker.
- If the striker takes a single, my player moves to the striker's end.
- If a catch comes towards my player while fielding, I get control of that player.
- Include realistic running between wickets and calling.

7. Full Match Experience

Allow players to play complete matches:

- T20
- ODI
- Test Cricket
- Domestic tournaments
- League tournaments
- International tournaments

Include toss, batting order, team selection, innings breaks, scorecards, player statistics and match results.

8. Player Customization

Allow customization of:

- Player name
- Face and appearance
- Hairstyle
- Jersey number
- Bat
- Shoes
- Helmet
- Gloves
- Cricket equipment

9. Career Statistics

Maintain complete career records:

- Total runs
- Batting average
- Strike rate
- Centuries and half-centuries
- Sixes and fours
- Wickets
- Bowling average
- Best bowling figures
- Catches
- Player rankings

10. Camera System

Include multiple camera angles:

- Third-person batting camera
- Broadcast camera
- Bowling camera
- Close-up catch camera
- Replay camera
- Stadium camera

11. AI Opponents

Create intelligent opponents with different batting and bowling abilities. Their performance should depend on match situations, pitch conditions and player skill.

12. Important Requirements

- Do not create a simple cricket mini-game.
- Build a complete interactive 3D cricket simulation.
- All buttons and controls must actually work.
- Every match should be playable.
- The player must be able to control batting, bowling and fielding.
- Add realistic animations instead of simple 2D movements.
- Create proper menus, settings, career selection and match selection.
- Save career progress automatically.
- Make the game mobile-friendly with smooth touch controls.

FINAL INSTRUCTION: Prioritize realistic cricket gameplay, complete career progression, manual batting and bowling, interactive fielding and high-quality 3D an

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
